stories.title: Donald Trump: Zustimmungswerte in den USA fallen vor Midterms auf Rekordtief

en.title: Donald Trump: Approval ratings in the USA fall to record low before midterms
en.summary: Trump's popularity has declined amid rising fuel and food prices and an ongoing Iran conflict. He is now courting a Democratic political figure instead.

stories.title: Möglicherweise Eingequetscht: 52-Jähriger stirbt bei Unfall an Free-Fall-Turm am Oktoberfest

en.title: Possibly crushed: 52-year-old dies in accident at free-fall tower at Oktoberfest
en.summary: A man died from severe injuries in a fatal incident at Oktoberfest involving a free-fall tower ride. Witnesses are receiving counseling support.

stories.title: Oktoberfest: Mitarbeiter stirbt bei Unfall mit Free-Fall-Turm

en.title: Oktoberfest: Employee dies in free-fall tower accident
en.summary: A ride operator was crushed and killed in an accident at a free-fall tower on the Munich Oktoberfest grounds. Crisis counselors are supporting witnesses.

stories.title: Oktoberfest: Oktoberfest: Mitarbeiter nach Fahrgeschäft-Unfall gestorben

en.title: Oktoberfest: Employee dies following ride accident
en.summary: A severe accident involving a free-fall tower at Munich's Oktoberfest resulted in the death of a ride worker. Investigations are underway.

stories.title: FIFA: Infantino bereit für Reformen - aber kein Rückzug

en.title: FIFA: Infantino ready for reforms - but no withdrawal
en.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino responded to ongoing criticism of his leadership by offering opponents discussions about potential reforms within the football governing body.

stories.title: machtkampf in der fifa: Infantino geht auf Kritiker zu – schließt eigenen Rückzug aber aus

en.title: Power struggle at FIFA: Infantino responds to critics but rules out own resignation
en.summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino addressed criticism of his leadership in a letter to the organization's 211 member associations while stating he will not step down.

stories.title: USA: Trumps Zustimmungswerte fallen auf Rekordtief

en.title: USA: Trump's approval ratings fall to record low
en.summary: Weeks before midterm elections, US President Trump's approval rating has reached its lowest point, with only 32 percent of Americans satisfied with his work according to a poll.

stories.title: CDU-Chef Peters tritt zurück, Amthor übernimmt

en.title: CDU chief Peters steps down, Amthor takes over
en.summary: CDU state leader Peters resigned following the party's poor performance in the state election and failure to re-enter the parliament. Federal minister Amthor will assume the leadership.

stories.title: Deutschland-Liveblog: Mecklenburg-Vorpommerns CDU-Chef Peters tritt zurück

en.title: Germany liveblog: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern's CDU chief Peters steps down
en.summary: CDU state leader Peters is stepping down, with Amthor set to take interim control. The cabinet approved draft legislation on fuel tax relief.

stories.title: Wahl in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern: CDU-Chef Peters geht, Amthor rückt nach

en.title: Election in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern: CDU chief Peters steps down, Amthor takes over
en.summary: CDU state party leader Daniel Peters resigned following the party's election defeat in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, with Philipp Amthor assuming the position on an interim basis.

stories.title: Newsblog zu den Landtagswahlen: Spitzenkandidat Peters tritt nach CDU-Debakel in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern zurück

en.title: News blog on state elections: Top candidate Peters steps down after CDU debacle in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
en.summary: The CDU in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern failed to enter a state parliament for the first time in German federal history after Sunday's election.

stories.title: Paramount und Warner Bros.: Einigung im Streit um 111-Milliarden-Fusion

en.title: Paramount and Warner Bros.: Agreement in dispute over 111 billion dollar merger
en.summary: After twelve US states sued to block Warner Brothers' acquisition, the deal was paused. The parties have now reached agreement on a transaction valued at approximately 111 billion US dollars.

stories.title: Nikkei Futures und CSI 300: Asiens Börsen profitieren von Techwerten und Hoffnungen auf US-China-Gipfel

en.title: Nikkei Futures and CSI 300: Asian stock markets benefit from tech stocks and hopes for US-China summit
en.summary: Asian investors are optimistic about a potential extension of the US-China trade agreement and enthusiasm for Meta's AI assistant Muse, supporting market sentiment.

stories.title: USA: Nach Hausverbot – Sender klagen gegen Trump, auch Fox News protestiert

en.title: USA: After Ban – Networks Sue Trump, Fox News Also Protests
en.summary: The President's decision to remove CNN, MSNBC, and Politico from the White House has faced legal challenges. Even Trump-friendly media figures have expressed solidarity by refusing to attend White House events.

stories.title: +++ Bundespolitik +++: Kabinett beschließt 17 Cent weniger Energiesteuer auf Sprit

en.title: Federal Politics: Cabinet Approves 17 Cent Reduction in Energy Tax on Fuel
en.summary: The government cabinet has decided to reduce energy taxes on gasoline by 17 cents. Union business groups are calling for implementation of broader reforms before winter.

stories.title: Kommentar: SPD und Grüne brauchen eine Brandmauer gegen Enteignungen

en.title: Commentary: SPD and Greens Need a Firewall Against Expropriations
en.summary: A commentary argues that Berlin requires more housing solutions rather than symbolic socialist policies that burden taxpayers, property owners, and investors.

stories.title: António Guterres: Covid, Gaza, Trump: Warum der UN-Generalsekretär nur scheitern konnte

en.title: António Guterres: Covid, Gaza, Trump: Why the UN Secretary-General Could Only Fail
en.summary: The Portuguese UN Secretary-General is making his final major appearance at the General Assembly this week before stepping down at year-end. His tenure is assessed as decidedly mixed.
